caption: The drawing depicts a box-shaped object with wooden frame accents and panels that appear to be made of metal. The wooden portions are shown in brown tones and include a top and bottom base as well as four turned columns at each corner. The box has dotted holes distributed across the metal surface on both the sides and the open door at the front, which is attached with visible hinges and a simple latch mechanism. On the inside, there is a smaller metallic container positioned centrally near the back of the main box. The top of the box has two elongated slots and a thin, black, curved wire handle attached for carrying. The overall color scheme includes greenish-gray for the metal parts, brown for the wooden portions, and black for the metal handle. The background is a plain, off-white surface with a faint rectangular border framing the composition.
title: Foot Warmer
